list: Official 55 trophy identities from the supplied GTA VI kit list.
note: Names, descriptions, and grades are official identity fields. Route order, guide advice, and estimates are editorial; the game is unreleased, so unconfirmed mechanics are identified as uncertain.

phases.name: First Light
phases.goal: Complete the opening mission and establish the campaign route.
phases.about: Begin with the required opening mission so the story flow is established before optional cleanup. Wait for the game to confirm that the wider map is available.

phases.name: Main Story
phases.goal: Complete Chapters 1 through 4 and the final mission.
phases.about: Keep story milestones together before the broad open-world sweep. Named missions may be placed differently in the release build, so follow the mission board rather than guessing exact chapter order.

phases.name: Stranger Lines
phases.goal: Close named character strands and stranger-related objectives.
phases.about: A strand checklist helps distinguish a finished line from one merely started. Character availability and region gates are unverified until the released game can be checked.

phases.name: Crime and Getaways
phases.goal: Work through robberies, escapes, and crime-focused challenges.
phases.about: Group preparation-heavy crime activities into focused sessions. Read each activity prompt before committing because exact rules and fail states are not verified.

phases.name: Activities and Skills
phases.goal: Sample activities, races, range challenges, and repeatable skills.
phases.about: Keep a running record for cumulative counts and distinct event wins. The release may present trackers differently from current list wording, so prefer in-game records.

phases.name: Across Leonida
phases.goal: Explore regions and finish world, property, and encounter objectives.
phases.about: Move district by district to reduce backtracking and make unexplored areas easy to spot. The game’s map and discovery tracker are the authority on what counts.

phases.name: Collection and Completion
phases.goal: Finish card sets, location totals, and the 100% completion audit.
phases.about: Concentrate on tracked collections after the world is open. Keep the completion screen as the checklist because the short trophy descriptions do not enumerate every counted task.

phases.name: Final Check
phases.goal: Reconcile the checklist and earn the platinum capstone.
phases.about: The platinum is the final audit, not a separate activity. Compare the console trophy list with your local ticks before the final requirement is completed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.requires: All other campaign chapters, activities, district discoveries, and completion-tracker requirements.
trophies.missable: The platinum itself is not expected to be missable; whether any contributing trophy has a permanent condition is unverified, so audit warnings as they appear.
steps: Open the console trophy list before the final cleanup session.
Compare every entry with your local checklist.
Use the game’s completion tracker to locate any remaining requirement.
Finish the outstanding chapter, activity, or collection task.
Confirm the platinum award after the last requirement registers.
trophies.guide: This capstone asks for the other fifty-four trophies. Use the console list and completion tracker together as your final checklist. A useful last-session habit is to resolve every visible gap before attempting an uncertain hidden condition. Keep a separate note of trophies whose requirements are not fully explained. Since GTA VI is unreleased, award timing and cleanup rules remain unverified.
trophies.hint: Reconcile the console list with your checklist before the final unlock.
trophies.verification: Confirm the platinum entry appears in the console trophy list after the final requirement.
sources: Official GTA VI trophy list supplied with the kit: title and description.
Trophy Atlas route notes; release behavior remains unverified.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.requires: The campaign opening mission, Gone Fishing.
trophies.missable: Not expected to be missable because it is the opening mission; replay access is unverified, so finish it during the first story pass.
steps: Start the campaign and read the opening prompt.
Select or follow the Gone Fishing mission marker.
Complete each objective shown on screen.
Wait for the mission completion state to appear.
Check the console trophy list before leaving the opening sequence.
trophies.guide: This trophy asks you to complete Gone Fishing. Begin the campaign and follow its opening objectives through the finish. Check that the mission is recorded complete rather than stopping at a checkpoint. A practical tip is to let the closing sequence finish before quitting. Mission flow and replay options remain unverified until release.
trophies.hint: Follow the opening marker until the game records Gone Fishing as finished.
trophies.verification: Confirm Just Like Paradise is earned after the Gone Fishing mission completes.
sources: Official GTA VI trophy list supplied with the kit: exact mission identity.

trophies.missable: Not expected to be missable; property unlock conditions and any limited offers are unknown, so inspect listings as they appear.
steps: Open the property or garage listings.
Record each property identified as a garage.
Check its price and unlock requirements.
Purchase each available garage and confirm ownership.
Revisit the list for locked or unowned garages and verify the trophy.
trophies.guide: Little Boxes asks you to purchase all garage properties. Use the property listings as the authoritative inventory. Separate garages from other property types when tracking purchases. Check locked entries after story progress rather than assuming the list is complete. The number of garages, costs, and unlock conditions remain unverified before release.
trophies.hint: Keep a garage-only property checklist and revisit locked listings later.
trophies.verification: Confirm every garage property is owned and Little Boxes is earned.
sources: Official GTA VI trophy list supplied with the kit: garage-property requirement.
Property count and availability need release verification.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.requires: The Scooter Bros app and vehicle registration points or prompts in Leonida.
trophies.missable: Not expected to be missable as a registration total; duplicate rules and app availability are unknown, so use distinct vehicles if possible.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app and read registration instructions.
Find a vehicle eligible for registration.
Submit its registration and check that it appears in the app.
Record the vehicle before registering another one.
Repeat until ten are registered and verify the trophy.
trophies.guide: On the Spot asks you to register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Follow the app’s own instructions and check the registered list after each submission. Use distinct vehicles unless the game confirms duplicates count. A useful tip is to keep a simple list so a missing registration is easy to find. App access and duplicate rules remain unverified before release.
trophies.hint: Confirm each vehicle appears in the Scooter Bros app before counting it.
trophies.verification: Confirm ten vehicles are listed in the app and On the Spot is earned.
sources: Official GTA VI trophy list supplied with the kit: ten-vehicle registration requirement.
App workflow and duplicate rules need release verification.
